title: The memstore role-pair rejection names the fields of the descriptor, a subset readback gets the nest route, and both routes build as written
proves: the copy route of the unread-memstore rejection, pasted as written, is ready (employments_copy)
the role-pair route for a readback with the producer count, followed as written, is ready (audit_refs)
a readback without count, with the producer count or above it reads every producer row once and is ready
a readback whose literal count is below the literal producer count (producer - 1, and 0) leads with the nest route, names both products and a producer field in the count example
a readback with the producer count, above it, without count or with a braces count gets the role template, not the nest route
a braces producer count gives no nest route, because Build cannot compare it
the role template names the declared producer identifier and the consumer key that copies it, also under another name
a consumer that does not copy the identifier is told which key to add
a consumer that already has a key of the identifier name with another script is told to set that script, not to add a second key
a foreign key without a producer identifier gets the identifier role filled from its parent_field
without roles the template never names one copied field as the identifier: it states that the field must differ in every row
without roles the template lists the producer fields that the readback copies
the copy route of the unread-memstore rejection names the declared producer identifier, and keeps placeholders without one
a nested braces count names the parent's fields bare; parent.<field> in the count fails

negatives.name: readback_below_the_producer_count
negatives.remediation: "audits" sets a count below the rows of "employments", so this readback cannot pass. Move <generate name="audits"> inside <generate name="employments">

negatives.name: subset_route_names_a_producer_field_and_max_count
negatives.remediation: A nested braces count runs in the parent row: it counts the child rows for each parent row and names the parent's fields bare, count="{1 if employment_id % 2 == 1 else 0}"; only the child's keys write parent.<field>. A braces count stops Build from deriving max_count, and without max_count Build stops at 10 rows: set "max_count" at the top level of acceptance/build.json to the rows of all products together; 2000 is safe.

negatives.name: readback_with_the_producer_count
negatives.remediation: Add the consumer foreign-key role, or point an existing one at the producer's identifier field: {"product": "audits", "field": "employment_id", "role": {"kind": "foreign_key", "parent_product": "employments", "parent_field": "employment_id"}}. First add <key name="employment_id" script="this.employment_id"/> to audits.

negatives.remediation: Add the consumer foreign-key role, or point an existing one

negatives.remediation: Add the consumer foreign-key role, or point an existing one

negatives.remediation: Add the consumer foreign-key role, or point an existing one

negatives.remediation: Add the consumer foreign-key role, or point an existing one

patch.old:
<generate name="employments" count="4" target="mem">
        <key name="employment_id" generator="IncrementGenerator"/>
        <key name="person_id" script="(employment_id + 1) // 2"/>
    </generate>
    <generate name="audits" count="2">
patch.new:
<generate name="employments" count="{2 * 2}" target="mem">
        <key name="employment_id" generator="IncrementGenerator"/>
        <key name="person_id" script="(employment_id + 1) // 2"/>
    </generate>
    <generate name="audits" source="mem" sourceEntity="employments" distribution="ordered" count="3">

<generate name="audits" source="mem" sourceEntity="employments" distribution="ordered">
        <key name="employment_id" script="this.employment_id"/>

<generate name="audits" source="mem" sourceEntity="employments" distribution="ordered">
        <key name="emp_ref" script="this.employment_id"/>

negatives.name: readback_key_of_the_identifier_name_with_another_script
negatives.remediation: Set the script of key "employment_id" in audits to this.employment_id.

patch.new:
<generate name="audits" source="mem" sourceEntity="employments" distribution="ordered">
        <key name="employment_id" script="this.employment_id + 0"/>

negatives.name: no_roles_one_copied_field_keeps_the_condition
negatives.remediation: Add two product_roles entries: {"product": "employments", "field": "<employment_id: the field that differs in every row>"

negatives.name: no_roles_list_the_copied_fields
negatives.remediation: Add two product_roles entries: {"product": "audits", "field": "<audit_id or team: the field that differs in every row>"

patch.new:
<generate name="audits" count="2" target="mem">
        <key name="audit_id" generator="IncrementGenerator"/>
        <key name="team" script="audit_id % 2"/>
    </generate>
    <generate name="audit_copy" source="mem" sourceEntity="audits" distribution="ordered">
        <key name="audit_id" script="this.audit_id"/>
        <key name="team" script="this.team"/>
    </generate>

negatives.name: unread_memstore_names_the_identifier
negatives.remediation: <key name="employment_id" script="this.employment_id"/></generate> and the product_roles {"product": "employments", "field": "employment_id", "role": {"kind": "identifier"}} and {"product": "employments_copy", "field": "employment_id"

patch.old:
<generate name="employments_copy" source="mem" sourceEntity="employments" distribution="ordered" target="ConsoleExporter"><key name="employment_id" script="this.employment_id"/></generate>
    <!-- The role-pair route, followed: a readback with the producer count gets the key that copies the identifier. -->
    <generate name="audit_refs" source="mem" sourceEntity="employments" distribution="ordered" count="4">
        <key name="audit_id" generator="IncrementGenerator"/>
        <key name="employment_id" script="this.employment_id"/>
patch.new:
<generate name="employments_copy" count="4"><key name="employment_id" generator="IncrementGenerator"/></generate>
    <generate name="audit_refs" count="4">
        <key name="audit_id" generator="IncrementGenerator"/>
        <key name="employment_id" script="audit_id"/>
